## AI-Generated Fix (javascript)

```javascript
const express = require('express');
const helmet = require('helmet');
const app = express();

// Use Helmet to hide X-Powered-By header
app.use(helmet.hidePoweredBy());

// Serve static files without revealing version information
app.use('/static', express.static('public', {
  setHeaders: (res, path, stat) => {
    res.set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000');
  }
}));

app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  res.send('Welcome to the secure web application!');
});

app.listen(8882, () => {
  console.log('Server is running on http://34.16.47.248:8882');
});
```

## Explanation

The vulnerability was due to the disclosure of the Font Awesome version, which could be exploited by attackers. The fix involves using the Helmet middleware to hide the 'X-Powered-By' header, which prevents revealing server technology and version information. Additionally, static files are served with headers that prevent MIME type sniffing and enable caching, further reducing the risk of version disclosure.
